_doc: World.Geo import tuning (T-003): the single source of truth; the importer refuses to build if a key is missing. terrainMaxErrorM is the RTIN split threshold; RTIN accumulates per-split error, so the measured deviation from the 1 m geo_tile surface is about 2x the setting (L0_30_36: max 0.196 m, RMS 0.033 m, 589,457 triangles). Physics uses the full-resolution surface. Palette values are unstyled placeholders (T-004 restyles).
